capability.name: Gestión documental transversal
intents: vincular un documento a un objeto de negocio
compartir o revocar un documento entre organizaciones
aplicar retención legal o legal hold
buscar documentos por contenido y metadatos
gestionar originales renditions y evidencia fiscal

dependencies: tenant legal entity and branch context
outbox events and immutable audit trail
restrictions: the document master metadata and immutable versions are distinct from the business transaction that references them
AP AR POS Payroll Inventory and Ledger own business meaning while DMS owns content metadata versions links grants and retention
fiscal generation signature and authority response remain owned by Electronic Fiscal Documents
a shared document uses one content object with tenant-scoped grants rather than uncontrolled copies
cross-organization visibility requires an active consented relationship and an explicit revocable grant
retention legal hold storage tier metadata schemas and access policy are governed configuration
OCR extraction creates attributable candidates and never mutates or posts a business fact
deletion never bypasses retention legal hold audit or evidence-preservation policy

deterministic: inspect document metadata versions links grants retention and integrity state
trace a document from source content through linked business objects
verify content hash version history and access provenance
identify retention policy and legal-hold effects without mutating content
poDecision: approve the DMS service boundary and rollout
approve document taxonomies metadata schemas and retention classes
approve external sharing signature and OCR scope
approve jurisdictional archive and WORM policy
architectHandoff: search indexing OCR and rendition pipeline
signature KMS retention WORM and purge architecture
reviewerGate: audited access share download and purge
malware content-type size and duplicate controls
BFF-only user access and protected download URLs
forbiddenWithoutApproval: share a document outside its tenant
change a signature or KMS policy
enable an OCR or storage provider

retrieval.provenance: Document Management capability derived from proposed UBP ADR-0044 and partial Graphify anchors at pinned UBP revision ebf1c845bdf917d821f3182bff0cbe04c21d2c8e. A transversal repository, version lifecycle, retention/WORM, signature, search and shared-document runtime are not yet demonstrated.
